events.name: Anaheim Ducks at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — Stefan Noesen, Paul Cotter and Cody Glass each scored to help the New Jersey Devils beat the Anaheim Ducks 4-1 on Saturday and snap a five-game home losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Devils beat the Ducks 4-1 to end a 5-game home losing streak

headlines.description: — Joel Eriksson Ek scored with 23.1 seconds remaining to lift the Minnesota Wild to a 3-2 win over the Ottawa Senators on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Joel Eriksson Ek's late goal lifts Wild past Senators 3-2

events.name: San Jose Sharks at Pittsburgh Penguins

headlines.description: — John Klingberg capped off a frantic late rally by scoring his second goal of the game 2:57 into overtime to lift the San Jose Sharks to an improbable 6-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Penguins on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sharks rally from four-goal third-period deficit to stun Sidney Crosby and the Penguins 6-5

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Emil Heineman and Mathew Barzal scored in the shootout, and the New York Islanders defeated the Tampa Bay Lightning 3-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Barzal, Heineman lift Islanders past Lightning 3-2 in shootout

events.name: Edmonton Oilers at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Connor McDavid had two goals and an assist and Tristan Jarry made 25 saves in his first game for Edmonton, helping the Oilers beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 6-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: McDavid has 2 goals and an assist to back Jarry in Oilers' 6-3 win over Maple Leafs

events.name: Montreal Canadiens at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — J.T. Miller scored his second goal of the game on a power play at 2:56 of overtime as the New York Rangers rallied to beat the Montreal Canadiens 5-4 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Miller scores 2, including OT winner, as Rangers beat Canadiens 5-4

headlines.description: — Jackson Blake scored in the shootout, and the Eastern Conference-best Carolina Hurricanes beat the Philadelphia Flyers 4-3 on Saturday night to open a home-and-home set.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jackson Blake scores in shootout as East-best Hurricanes top Flyers 4-3

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Ben Hutton and Brayden McNabb scored in the third period, and the Vegas Golden Knights continued their strong road run, beating the Columbus Blue Jackets 3-2 on Saturday night for their sixth win in seven games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hutton, McNabb lift Golden Knights past Blue Jackets 3-2

headlines.description: — Connor Hellebuyck made 24 saves in his return from a knee injury, Gabriel Vilardi scored twice and the Winnipeg Jets beat the Washington Capitals 5-1 on Saturday night to end a three-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hellebuyck makes 24 saves in return from knee injury, Jets beat Capitals 5-1

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Chicago Blackhawks

headlines.description: — Alex DeBrincat scored twice and had an assist, John Gibson earned his second shutout in three starts, and the Detroit Red Wings beat the Chicago Blackhawks 4-0 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alex DeBrincat scores twice as Red Wings shut out Blackhawks 4-0

headlines.description: — Sergei Bobrovsky made 15 saves for his third shutout this season to continue his mastery of Dallas, and Brad Marchand had two goals and an assist as the Florida Panthers blanked the Stars 4-0 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sergei Bobrovsky and Brad Marchand lead Panthers to 4-0 win over Stars

headlines.description: — Nathan MacKinnon scored his NHL-leading 26th goal and added an assist, and the Colorado Avalanche beat the Nashville Predators 4-2 on Saturday night for their 11th straight home win.
headlines.shortLinkText: MacKinnon has goal and assist as Avalanche beat Predators 4-2 for 11th straight home win

events.name: Calgary Flames at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Morgan Frost scored in overtime and Blake Coleman had a short-handed goal in the Calgary Flames’ 2-1 victory over the Los Angeles Kings on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Morgan Frost scores in OT to lift the Flames past the Kings, 2-1
